title: Mother tongue dilemma
content:
Till date one of my greatest regret is my inability to converse fluently in my mother’s tongue. I hear small but I speak next to nothing and it irks me daily.
However, there is this guy when I was a teacher bah omo the guy dey suffocate me with Igbo. From the first day we met, after we introduced ourselves the guy start dey fire me Igbo oh. Normally I don’t have control over my facial expression so when the guy look my face I don’t know what he saw oh but next thing he asked me “You no be Igbo?” I said no
I don’t know what I look like but is like I resemble various tribes cos Yoruba people see me and speak Yoruba, likewise Igbo people. I originally intended to learn Igbo when I served in Ebonyi but the language nor gree me learn.
I enjoy the language melodic tune and contraction of mixing vowels e.g. Mister Obinna will be Mistobinna, Oguche and other related stuff. Most times when I hear people conversing in Igbo I’ll just stand in one corner and be enjoying.
Back to my former colleague, the guy at the slightest opportunity will never cease to jabber rapidly in Igbo to me. I don tire to tell am say I nor dey hear Igbo so I the master strategist devised a method to cope with the guy.
My plan was simple, whenever he’s speaking I’ll be watching his facial expression and then I’ll be picking one or two words I knew in Igbo and piece them together. One day, the guy was speaking I was watching his expression it was excited. Then I picked words like agwo, miri, agwu and ahia. So I just concluded that he was excited because snake sell water for lion inside market. Na so we dey coexist oh.
One day in 2020 before lockdown we did cultural day in school and my south-south people insisted that I dressed in native attire. I refused but them say if I nor tie wrapper no food for me so boom I just asked them if green wrapper and yellow top go rhyme 😂😂😂😂😂😂😂 me and food right?
Well during the program my guy came to our canopy and just started firing Igbo for me while laughing so I assumed he was telling a joke. Simple thing, I faced him eye to eye, nodding my head and was smiling while he was cracking his joke.
I was just nodding before I realized that the guy had stopped talking and was staring at me. Is like he had gotten to the part where I was supposed to say something and here I was smiling and nodding. Be like them don catch me nod headed Ahbi red handed or how dem dey talk am. 
The next thing the guy just ask me: “Guy you no be Igbo?”
Without loosing my smile and nodding I just said: “Not in the slightest” then walked away.
To be continued….

title: Rafael
content:
Think vampires don’t exist? Well, think again.
I don’t really recall the original meeting but somewhere between the late 90s and early 2000s I was more of his nemesis. I remember he used to be small with big head and I used to taunt him.
A particular incident that we always laugh about was when I was in primary 3, he was a class lower than mine. Whenever I saw him I’ll always call him primary 1 boy, he will say something and then take off. That day he told me boldly he wasn’t scared of me and immediately he took off. I was about giving chase as our manner was when I noticed that his knicker got caught on a door. I just laughed and left him without thinking much of it. Later on, we were in class and heard laughter. Came out to peep and well it was hilarious.
Turned out my guy won class election as class captain. Form teacher noticed he was holding his shorts with one hand and ordered him to raise the hand. The door had actually torn his elastic so gravity took control and my guy stood in all his glory with his power rangers pant 😌😌😌😌. He never lets me forget that incident till date.
When we wrote common entrance he was among the pry 5 brought to write with us because the guy is actually very intelligent. In fact, he topped a lot of pry 6 and was among the best 10. Later on we were selected among the golden 7 of our set for extra extra-mural lesson because we were shortlisted for gifted. So when school lesson concluded we were to remain and somehow we became buddies. 
JS 1 we resumed and although we were all selected he didn’t resume with us because he was to complete pry 6. Towards the end of first term however, much to my happiness he joined us in boarding house. If I go through all our chaotic behaviors and troubles in boarding school I’ll be writing for weeks with no end in sight and some people will discover things dey didn’t know we were behind. Teaming up with our trusted buddies then Francis, Efe and Abuchi we actually committed a lot in that gwagwalada town. 
From the yam barn incidence to being chased by mad cow or even eating in the night inside bush. Me and this guy story shows we were legends. Like I said I won’t mention some heist we both pulled especially against each other. Somehow sha he luckily wasn’t involved in the scenario that saw me and Francis Obdk tumbling from a mango tree with the branch 😂😂😂😂😂😂😂😂
As fate would have it we were both in commercial class and I literally chose every subject I offered based on what my guy was doing and coincidentally on the day of post ume we both met at university of Abuja. Unplanned tho it was we had both applied for same course, scored 2 points (142, 144. He was higher sha) within each other and secured admission to study accounting. We became course mates again till I left the school 3 years later. He was our chef in skool as well as our maths guru oh. The guy writes like crazy, poetry boss and rap lord sote all of us had our special book to offer when his hands start itching to write.
For those who don't know him, people call him head buster, bone crusher, worm tail, RZB but he is Raphael Ndifreke Ibangha.
This is the only friend I have that didn’t grow up in my compound but knows me as much as my family. The longest academic friend I made. Vampire that refused to age but at least he has bald hair that defeats my own so I nor vex. 
I may not be his best man on his wedding day but I’m sure if I want to make money I’ll collect mic because he will have to bribe me not to say whatever I want to say. The epistle is becoming too long but anything for my guy. 
Today I want to wish my best friend, longest friend, oldest friendship and one of the most beneficial friendship I was fortunate enough to have at an early age a happy birthday. You are a good person and although the world has been dark a lot of times to you I know you will always be a good person. Let the ungrateful continue their ways you will always stand strong. 
Happy birthday my extended brother may today bring you continuous blessings, upliftment and consistent breakthrough. Who knows maybe in our next life you will pay my school fees because I’m very sure we both died in one war in our former life and we know whose idea it would have been to fight in the war.
Happy birthday Rafa EL 
Am I too loud?
PS: Our first official photo taken in 2010 (10+ years after we met) when we just completed 100 level vs us few months back at Victor’s wedding vs us few weeks later going on an unplanned visit
To be continued…
